depicted: The Taj Mahal, with its central dome and four minarets, stands on top of a dark rocky cliff. Waterfalls pour down both sides of the rock into a pool below, green shrubs cling to the ledges, and white cumulus clouds fill a blue sky with a violet patch at top right.
real_world_reference: Taj Mahal (Agra, India) - the building is unmistakable; the cliff and waterfalls are invented.
mood: serene and grand, with a surreal twist
issues: Title and description avoid naming the Taj Mahal, which is unmistakable, and call it an 'imagined palace'. It is a mausoleum, not a palace, and it does not hover: it sits on a rock cliff with waterfalls on both sides, which the text never mentions.
proposed_desc_en: The Taj Mahal lifted out of Agra and set on a dark rock cliff, with waterfalls spilling down both sides into the pool below. Towering clouds drift behind the dome in a bright blue sky.
alt_text: The Taj Mahal on a dark rock cliff with waterfalls pouring down both sides, under a blue sky with large white clouds
quality_note: The marble reads peach rather than white, which may be a warm colour cast in the photo; otherwise clean and full-frame.
old_desc: An imagined white palace hovers above a dark escarpment, lit like a memory rather than a monument.

depicted: A stylised Ganesha: an elephant head in orange and gold with large red-rimmed ears, a trunk curling down to the left and a red U-shaped tilak on the forehead, set against panels of deep blue and dark red. Curved teal and green bands fill the lower half, with a small yellow flame-like shape on each side.
real_world_reference: Ganesha, the Hindu elephant-headed deity; the fragmented background resembles stained glass or cubist stylisation.
issues: This is Ganesha, not a 'ceremonial elephant': the forehead tilak and the head-and-trunk iconography make the deity unmistakable. Title and description never name him, and 'festival fire' and 'pageantry' describe nothing visible. Filed under 'creatures' in works.json; it belongs with deities or devotion.
proposed_desc_en: Ganesha built from sweeping curves of orange and gold, his trunk curling down past a red tilak, his ears rimmed in red against panels of deep blue. Curved bands of teal and green rise around him from below.
alt_text: Stylised Ganesha head in orange and gold with red-rimmed ears, curling trunk and red forehead mark on blue and red panels
quality_note: Grainy, speckled texture over the whole image (surface or photo noise); the tilak is cut by the top edge, so the crop may be tight.
old_desc: A ceremonial elephant emerges in saturated reds and golds, equal parts strength, pageantry, and dream.

depicted: Two elderly men in a warm yellow room. One in white sits on a wooden cot with a white cloth across his lap, cutting it with scissors, a spinning wheel on the table beside him and a larger spoked wheel below; the other, in a yellow-green turban, dark shawl and white dhoti, sits barefoot on the floor looking up at him. Signed 'Pinkal' and dated 25-02-13 at lower right.
real_world_reference: A charkha (Indian spinning wheel) is shown; the seated man is not identifiable as a specific person. The scene resembles a village tailor or khadi worker at home.
issues: No supper, food or night anywhere: the scene is a bright yellow room and the seated man is cutting cloth beside a spinning wheel. 'Midnight Supper' is invented. The description's 'two figures in a glow' is true but says nothing about the craft that is the real subject.
proposed_desc_en: An old man in white sits on a wooden cot cutting cloth with scissors, a spinning wheel at his elbow, while a turbaned friend settles on the floor to talk. The whole room is washed in warm yellow light.
alt_text: Old man in white on a wooden cot cutting cloth with scissors beside a spinning wheel; a turbaned man sits on the floor
quality_note: Slightly soft focus; thin dark bands along the left and right edges may be the canvas sides.
old_desc: Two figures sit within a quiet theatrical glow, as though the conversation matters more than the room around them.

depicted: A misty forest of tall, slender grey trunks fading into pale blue-white haze, with scattered clusters of red blossom on the nearer branches. Dense green undergrowth with small red flowers fills the bottom, and a scatter of small birds (about seven) flies through the bright gap between the trees. Signed 'Pinkal' at lower right.
issues: Red is only an accent: a few blossom clusters on otherwise grey, misty trees. 'Crimson Grove' and 'burns softly with red blossoms' make the forest sound red, and both omit the mist and the birds, which carry the picture.
proposed_desc_en: Slender grey trunks dissolve into pale mist, a few branches of red blossom catching the light, while a scatter of birds crosses the bright gap above the green undergrowth.
alt_text: Tall grey tree trunks in pale mist with clusters of red blossom, green bushes below and small birds flying through the gap
quality_note: Slightly soft focus and low contrast; otherwise clean.
old_desc: A deep woodland burns softly with red blossoms, turning a familiar forest into a place of enchantment.

depicted: A bay horse with a black mane, seen from the front, wearing a dark leather bridle with a thin lead rope hanging loose, one foreleg raised. In the lower left, a small herd of four or five pale horses gallops through dust. The background is a smoky wash of sand, brown and grey-green. Signed 'Pinkal' at lower right.
real_world_reference: No named place or breed; the raised-foreleg stance resembles a dressage 'Spanish walk', though that is a guess.
issues: There is no lion anywhere in the painting; the description's 'lion and horse' is wrong. The picture is a single bridled bay horse with a small herd galloping behind it. 'Beasts of One Breath' is vague and inherits the lion error.
proposed_desc_en: A bay horse in a leather bridle lifts one foreleg and turns its head, black mane falling over a gleaming neck. Behind it, small and pale, a herd gallops through the dust.
alt_text: Bay horse in a leather bridle lifting one foreleg; a small herd of pale horses gallops in the dusty background
quality_note: A thin strip of the canvas side shows along the right edge and lighting is slightly uneven; otherwise sharp.
old_desc: Lion and horse share the same restless field, a meeting of courage and instinct inside one imagined world.

depicted: A village courtyard: two women in green and pink sarees sit on the sandy ground beside metal and clay pots and a small fire, while a third in a red saree walks away with a water pot balanced on her head. At left is a stone well with a wooden pulley and bucket; a black goat, a pale goat lying down and a brown horned cow share the yard with white-walled, tile-roofed houses and green trees under a pale blue sky.
real_world_reference: Rural Indian village; the sarees, well and tiled white houses resemble western India (Gujarat or Rajasthan), but no named place.
issues: Nothing in the painting is blue-dominated or indoors: it is a sunlit outdoor village yard in sand, red and green. There is no mother-and-child motif; the three women are carrying water, cooking and sitting by the pots, alongside a well, a cow and goats.
proposed_desc_en: Chores in a village yard: two women crouch over pots and a small fire while a third carries water home on her head past the stone well. A cow, two goats and whitewashed houses with tiled roofs complete the scene.
alt_text: Village yard: two women in sarees by pots and a fire, a third carrying a water pot on her head, a well, a cow and goats
old_desc: Three figures gather in a calm interior of blue, where tenderness becomes the true subject of the painting.

depicted: A crimson rosella parrot, red with blue cheeks, blue wing-edges and a blue tail, perches on a bare brown branch bearing clusters of small red berries. Snow lies on the branch and on the bird's back, and white flakes fall across a streaky turquoise-and-green background.
real_world_reference: Crimson rosella (Platycercus elegans), an Australian parrot; fairly confident from the red body, blue cheeks, blue-edged wings and blue tail.
issues: Title and description are truthful but leave out the falling snow, which is the painting's defining feature; 'appetite' is inferred (the beak is closed, the bird is not feeding). Neither mentions that the bird is identifiable as a crimson rosella.
proposed_desc_en: A crimson rosella rests on a snow-dusted branch heavy with red berries, flakes settling on its back as they drift down through a turquoise-and-green sky.
alt_text: Red and blue parrot perched on a snowy branch of red berries, snow falling against a turquoise-green sky
quality_note: Slightly soft; a thin sliver of canvas edge shows at the far left.
old_desc: A lone bird pauses among scarlet fruit, holding a small moment of colour, poise, and appetite.

depicted: A single large butterfly, wings fully spread and seen from above, fills the picture: deep blue wings with big blue eyespots ringed in gold, yellow-and-black zigzag borders, and orange-brown forewing tips with white bars. It is painted across two upright canvases hung side by side, over a splattered blue, green, white and yellow background; signed 'Pinkal' bottom right.
real_world_reference: Resembles a buckeye or pansy butterfly (genus Junonia); the blue hindwings with large eyespots are closest to the Blue Pansy (Junonia orithya) found in India, though the colouring is stylised. Uncertain.
issues: 'Tide' in the title has no visible basis beyond the diagonal sweep of light in the background. The description is honest but generic: it does not mention the eyespots, the orange-tipped forewings or that the work is a two-panel diptych.
proposed_desc_en: A buckeye-like butterfly opens its wings across two canvases, its blue-centred eyespots, gold zigzag borders and orange-tipped forewings standing out against a splattered blue-and-green ground.
alt_text: Blue and gold butterfly with eyespots, wings spread across two canvases on a splattered blue-green background
quality_note: Two-panel work photographed together; the vertical gap between panels is part of the piece, not a scan fault. Slightly uneven lighting, brighter at top centre.
old_desc: Wings open against a cool blue field like a fragment of sky learning how to become alive.

depicted: A misty forest: dark tree trunks with bare, branching limbs stand in the foreground on both sides, paler grey trunks recede into white haze in the centre, and clusters of red blossom sit on the upper branches. Dense green shrubs with a few red flowers fill the bottom third, and six or seven small birds fly across the pale sky gap; signed 'Pinkal' bottom right.
issues: The description says the forest is dark with flowers glowing from within it; the painting is the opposite: pale, misty and cool, with modest red blossom on the branches. 'Bloomfire' overstates the blossom and misses the mist and the birds, which are the real subject. Something like 'Birds Through the Mist' would be truer.
proposed_desc_en: Dark trunks frame a clearing where paler trees fade into white mist; red blossom clings to the upper branches, green undergrowth fills the forest floor, and a few birds cross the gap of pale sky.
alt_text: Misty forest with dark tree trunks, red blossom on upper branches, green undergrowth and birds in a pale sky
quality_note: Soft, slightly low-contrast photo; a thin dark edge along the bottom and right suggests the frame or canvas edge is in the shot.
old_desc: This forest vision grows brighter and more electric, where flowers seem to glow from within the dark.

depicted: A woman in a red coat and red high heels sits hunched on grey stone steps at night, holding a translucent white umbrella; her face is hidden, her bare legs are crossed and a red handbag rests on the step beside her. Thick white flecks, reading as snow, fall across the dark navy sky and settle on the umbrella and stones; signed 'Pinkal' bottom right.
issues: No water is visible anywhere: she sits on stone steps under a night sky in falling snow, so 'Edge of Water' and 'between stone and tide' are invented. 'Softened weather' understates a heavy snowfall, and the red handbag and heels go unmentioned.
proposed_desc_en: A woman in a red coat and red heels sits hunched on stone steps at night beneath a clear umbrella, her red bag beside her, as snow falls thick and bright across the dark sky.
alt_text: Woman in red coat and heels sitting on stone steps at night under a clear umbrella while snow falls
quality_note: A pale strip of background shows along the left edge and bottom-left corner; the photo is slightly skewed.
old_title: Umbrella at the Edge of Water
old_desc: A solitary woman waits between stone and tide, sheltered by colour in a world of softened weather.

depicted: A green-and-blue butterfly with wings spread sits diagonally across three narrow upright canvases hung side by side, blue near the body shading to green and lime at the edges, with black veins and white spots along the dark wing margins. The background is a speckled wash of greens, blues and white.
real_world_reference: Stylised; no specific species identifiable. Loosely resembles a green swallowtail such as the emerald swallowtail, but without tails. Uncertain.
issues: The butterfly does not 'dissolve' into the background; it is crisply outlined with black veins and white spots and only shares the background's colours. The description also omits that the work spans three panels.
proposed_desc_en: A green-and-blue butterfly with black veins and white-spotted wing edges opens across three narrow canvases, its colours picked up again in the speckled green-and-blue ground behind it.
alt_text: Green and blue butterfly with white-spotted wing edges spread across three panels on a speckled green-blue background
quality_note: Low-resolution file (556x452) and soft; the gaps between the three panels show the wall behind; the lower-left wing runs off the left and bottom edges, possibly cropped.
old_desc: A green butterfly dissolves into its own background, as though nature is inventing camouflage out of light.

depicted: Black silhouettes of a couple dancing close under a red umbrella, the man in a hat and suit, the woman in a full skirt, standing on a dark wet surface that reflects them. Behind them the sky is in vertical bands of blue fading to white; thick drips of red, orange, yellow, green and blue paint run down from the top edge on both sides, rain streaks fall beneath the umbrella, and the signature 'Pinkal' sits bottom right.
real_world_reference: The popular 'couple dancing in the rain under a red umbrella' silhouette motif, topped with a drip-painted border; no specific place.
issues: Title and description are truthful, but the description misses the two things that make the picture its own: the couple are dancing, and thick multicoloured drips run down from the top of the canvas.
proposed_desc_en: A couple in silhouette, he in a hat and she in a full skirt, dance close under a red umbrella on a wet, mirroring street, while thick drips of red, yellow, green and blue paint run down from the top of the canvas.
alt_text: Silhouetted couple dancing under a red umbrella on a wet street, with colourful paint drips running down from the top
old_desc: Two figures under a single umbrella turn rain into intimacy and distance into companionship.

depicted: Two white swans with orange bills glide toward each other on a still blue lake at dusk, their reflections and those of bare black trees running down the water. Rows of leafless trees frame both sides, grey hills and a green bush sit in the middle distance, and the sky is deep blue with white stars fading to pale yellow at the horizon.
real_world_reference: Swans with orange bills, likely mute swans; no specific place.
issues: The description speaks of a single swan; the painting shows a pair facing each other. It also says nothing about the bare night forest, starry sky and hills that fill most of the canvas. The title is generic but not wrong.
proposed_desc_en: Two swans glide toward each other across a still lake at nightfall, bright white against bare black trees and a star-scattered blue sky. Grey hills and a tuft of green bank hold the quiet in place.
alt_text: Two white swans face each other on a blue lake at dusk, framed by bare black trees under a starry sky
old_desc: A swan moves through still water with the grace of a thought that refuses to break.

depicted: A sunlit forest glade with a turquoise pool: a three-step white waterfall spills over mossy ledges beside large rounded brown boulders, and a path of flat stepping stones climbs the grassy bank to a wooden post. One white swan with an orange bill floats in the foreground, a second small swan sits on the water in the left distance, and sunbeams slant through tall trees behind.
real_world_reference: Swans, likely mute swans; a landscaped garden-style stepped waterfall; no specific place.
issues: The description mentions only a swan and silence; the stepped waterfall, boulders, stepping stones and sunlit forest are the painting's main subject and go unmentioned, and there are two swans, not one. 'River' in the title is a stretch for a pool fed by a waterfall, but it passes.
proposed_desc_en: A white swan glides across a turquoise pool fed by a three-step waterfall, with mossy boulders and a path of flat stepping stones climbing the bank. Sunbeams slant through the tall trees behind, and a second swan floats in the distance.
alt_text: White swan on a turquoise pool below a three-step waterfall, with mossy boulders and stepping stones in a sunlit forest
quality_note: Signature at lower right sits against the edge and may be slightly cropped.
old_desc: The water carries the silence of a swan, stretching the scene into something meditative and slow.

depicted: Two small songbirds with bright blue backs and wings, orange-red breasts and white bellies share a broken grey-brown tree stump: one perches on top and leans down, the other clings to the side looking up. To the right a thin bare twig carries clusters of purple five-petalled flowers with white centres, against a blurred teal, green and blue background.
real_world_reference: Birds resemble eastern bluebirds (blue back, rusty breast); the flowers resemble periwinkle or violets, uncertain.
subjects: purple blossoms on a bare twig
proposed_desc_en: Two bluebird-like songbirds, blue-backed with orange-red breasts, share a broken tree stump: one leans down from the top while the other clings to its side. A bare twig of purple blossoms rises beside them against a soft teal background.
alt_text: Two blue birds with orange breasts on a broken tree stump beside a twig of purple flowers, teal background
quality_note: Signature at lower right is clipped by the edge of the photo.
old_desc: Two birds rest together on a weathered stump, turning a small perch into a study of closeness.

depicted: Two white swans on a park pond curve their necks together into a heart shape. A wooden-slatted bench with dark iron ends stands on a flower-dotted lawn in the left foreground; behind the pond, trees blaze orange-red, red and violet-blue, with pink, purple and red flowering shrubs along the bank and their colours reflected in the water. Signed and dated lower right.
real_world_reference: Swans, likely mute swans; a park pond with a bench; no specific place.
proposed_desc_en: Two white swans curve their necks into a heart on a park pond, watched over by an empty wooden bench on a flower-dotted lawn. Behind them the trees blaze orange, red and violet, with pink and purple shrubs along the bank.
alt_text: Two white swans form a heart on a pond beside a wooden park bench, under orange, red and violet trees
quality_note: Low resolution (677x456) and soft, colours slightly washed out; dated signature lower right.
old_desc: Paired swans create a mirror of elegance, doubling the calm and widening the feeling of balance.

depicted: One bare-branched brown tree spreads across four separate canvases hung side by side, each with a different background: pink-to-magenta with two small dark birds in flight, orange-red fading to cream with a small bird on a branch, deep blue with round dots of blue, green, yellow and white hanging as leaves, and pale mint green with more dot leaves. The trunk runs through the middle two panels.
real_world_reference: Popular 'four seasons tree' multi-panel motif; no specific place.
proposed_desc_en: One bare-branched tree spreads across four separate canvases, each a different colour: a pink sky with two birds in flight, a warm orange-red sky, a deep blue hung with round dots of leaves, and a fresh mint-green finish. Hung together they read as one tree passing through the seasons.
alt_text: Four-panel painting of one bare tree against pink, orange, blue and green skies, with birds and round dot leaves
quality_note: Four separate canvases photographed on a wall, with gaps and slight misalignment between the panels; only 321 px tall.
old_desc: Leaves gather every season at once, making the tree feel less botanical than visionary.

depicted: Close-up of a peacock in three-quarter view facing right: blue head and neck with a white eye patch and a crest of dark blue fan-tipped feathers, green scaled plumage at the shoulder, and behind it a fanned train of green feathers covered in eyespots ringed in lime, gold-orange, blue and navy. The painting spans three canvases; two vertical seams are visible.
real_world_reference: Indian peafowl (peacock) with its train displayed, the national bird of India.
proposed_desc_en: A peacock turns its blue head and neck toward the light while its fanned train fills the picture with green feathers and gold-rimmed blue eyespots. The painting spans three canvases hung side by side.
alt_text: Close-up of a blue peacock's head and neck against a fan of green eyespot feathers, painted across three canvases
quality_note: Three canvases with visible seams; lighting slightly dim and uneven with a cool colour cast.
old_desc: A peacock opens its presence like a ritual, rich with pride, pattern, and ornamental stillness.

depicted: A tall, narrow canvas with a black, bubble-textured disc cut off by the left edge, from which metallic gold rays fan out over streaks of turquoise, teal and cerulean blue. There is no stem, leaf or horizon; the whole picture is one close radial burst.
real_world_reference: Resembles a sunflower seed-head with gold petals seen very close, or a sun/eclipse; not certain.
issues: The title is a fair reading (black seed-head and gold rays on blue), though the picture could equally be a sun. The description's 'single sunflower rises' is not what is shown: there is no stem or whole flower, only a cropped disc at the left edge with rays, and 'summer distilled into symbol' is filler.
proposed_desc_en: A black, pebble-textured disc sits against the left edge while metallic gold rays fan out across streaks of turquoise and blue — a sunflower's heart seen so close it could be a sun.
alt_text: Black textured disc at left with metallic gold rays fanning across turquoise and blue streaks
old_desc: A single sunflower rises against blue with the certainty of summer distilled into symbol.

depicted: A stylised Ganesha in saffron, orange, red and gold: curved trunk, one tusk, a large ear, three red lines on the brow, a blue scroll-shaped crown, a yellow modak beside the trunk and a tiny grey mouse in the bottom-right corner. The ground is black with a red combed-texture block at upper left; a pale bud shape with a red mark and two trailing red lines stands at left; signed 'Pinkal' bottom left.
real_world_reference: Ganesha, the Hindu elephant-headed deity, with his mouse (Mushak) and a modak sweet; contemporary stylised treatment.
issues: Neither names the subject. This is unmistakably Ganesha — trunk, single tusk, modak, mouse — not a 'mask' or a 'portrait', and 'a face burns through red tones' reads like a guess made from the colours alone.
proposed_desc_en: Ganesha glows in saffron, red and gold against a dark, scratched ground, his trunk curling toward a modak, a blue crown above his head and his tiny mouse waiting in the corner. Three red lines mark his brow, and a pale bud with a red sign hangs beside him.
alt_text: Stylised Ganesha in orange, red and gold with a blue crown, a modak and a small mouse on a dark ground
quality_note: Slightly soft, low-resolution photo; faint canvas texture; no glare or frame.
old_desc: A face burns through red tones and shadow, part portrait and part emotional emblem.

depicted: A dark-haired woman with a wreath of pink blossoms plays a silver concert flute; from its tip a stream of red, yellow and white ribbons spreads into a night sky with planets and bubbles. Inside the stream are butterflies, women dancing in blue gowns, children in a balloon basket, a rider on a white horse on a wave bursting from a large conch shell, and white flowers cradling a castle and a domed city; a sunlit tree with birds and pink roses fills the right; signed 'Pinkal' with a date, bottom right.
real_world_reference: A silver Western concert flute and a conch shell are recognisable; no named landmark or deity, and the horse-rider is not clearly a specific figure.
issues: Both are compatible but thin: 'evening' is not in the picture (night on the left, sunlit day on the right), and the description names none of the imagery that makes the painting — butterflies, conch, horse rider, flower-cradled castles.
proposed_desc_en: A woman with pink blossoms in her hair plays a silver flute, and the music pours out as pictures: butterflies, dancers in blue, a rider on a white horse surfing out of a conch shell, and tiny castles cradled in white flowers. Night and planets fill the left; a sunlit tree, birds and a balloon fill the right.
alt_text: Woman with flowers in her hair plays a silver flute; butterflies, dancers, a horse rider and a conch flow from it
quality_note: Slightly soft; otherwise clean, no visible frame or glare.
old_desc: Music seems visible here, carried by a solitary figure who turns breath into atmosphere.

depicted: A small girl with reddish-brown hair and a headband, in a white dress and barefoot, holds a red umbrella and bends to look down at her feet while rain streaks the whole scene. Behind her are a black iron fence and gate, a large tree at left with a pale moon or glow behind it, a doorway with warm yellow light at right, and white daisies and red flowers in the grass; signed bottom right.
issues: The figure is a small barefoot girl, not a woman, and she is looking down at her feet in the rain, which the description misses. Rain and umbrella are right.
proposed_desc_en: A small girl in a white dress, barefoot under a red umbrella, bends to look at her toes in the rain. Daisies dot the wet grass, an iron gate stands behind her, and a lit doorway glows beside the trees.
alt_text: Barefoot girl in a white dress under a red umbrella looks down at her feet in the rain beside an iron fence
quality_note: Slightly soft; a thin dark canvas edge is visible along the right side.
old_desc: One woman, one umbrella, and a weather-filled pause that feels private even in the open air.

depicted: A large butterfly in blues, lavender and white with magenta-rimmed wings fills the canvas, perched on a curved blue bowl shape that holds small flowers. Behind it, bands of pink, green, yellow, blue and white swirl outward; small blue-and-white blossoms, pink flowers and red brush-like stamens are scattered at the edges, with an orange-red flame-like swirl at left; signed 'Pinkal' bottom right.
issues: Both fit. The description is generic though: 'imagined colour' hedges, and it says nothing about the rainbow swirl, the bowl of flowers or the scattered blossoms.
proposed_desc_en: A great blue butterfly with lavender, white and magenta-rimmed wings rests on a blue bowl of small flowers, while bands of pink, green, yellow and blue swirl out from it like a pinwheel. Tiny blossoms and red, brush-like flowers are scattered round the edges.
alt_text: Large blue and lavender butterfly on a blue bowl of flowers with swirling pink, green and blue bands behind
old_desc: A butterfly becomes a study in vivid contrast, less specimen than burst of imagined colour.

depicted: Black silhouettes of dancers — a woman in a teal dress with wild hair, a figure with an arm raised, a large man at right, small figures with arms up, one in a red striped shirt — surround a flame-painted guitar in blue, orange and red that floats unheld at the centre of a splattered field of red, orange, yellow, green and blue with white speckles. Treble clefs, musical notes, a saxophone silhouette and a wine bottle with a glass are scattered through it; a dark blue-black painted border surrounds the scene; signed 'Pinkal' bottom right.
real_world_reference: No named place or figure; a saxophone, treble clefs and notes, and a wine bottle with glass are recognisable.
issues: There is no guitarist: the guitar floats unheld at the centre, surrounded by many dancing silhouettes, notes, a saxophone and a bottle with a glass. 'Midnight' is not shown, but 'Strings' matches the central guitar and the dark border makes the title acceptable.
proposed_desc_en: Dancers in black silhouette — a woman in a teal dress, a man in a red striped shirt, figures with arms flung up — surround a flame-painted guitar floating at the centre of a splattered field of red, orange, green and blue. Treble clefs, notes, a saxophone and a bottle with a glass finish the party.
alt_text: Black silhouettes of dancers around a flame-painted guitar on a splattered red, orange, green and blue background
quality_note: Slight softness and slight vignetting at the corners; the dark border is painted, not a frame.
old_desc: The guitarist appears suspended inside sound, as if melody itself shaped the composition.

depicted: A lion's face, drawn in dark lines (eyes, nose, mouth) with a mane that merges into a dense field of splashed, dripped and blotted paint in orange, yellow, green, magenta and blue. A faint pale circle sits at the top centre above the head.
real_world_reference: Lion (male, with mane); no specific place or style beyond the splashed, dripped paint that is visible
subjects: faint pale circle at top (sun or moon, uncertain)
issues: The picture is a lion, not a house cat: a full mane and broad muzzle are visible. 'Painted Whiskers' and 'companion and mischief-maker' describe a pet, which misleads; the painting is a wild big cat emerging from splashed colour.
proposed_desc_en: A lion's face stares straight out of a riot of splashed colour - orange, yellow, green and magenta - with its mane dissolving into the drips and blots around it. Only the dark lines of the eyes, nose and mouth hold the animal still.
alt_text: Lion's face emerging from splashes of orange, yellow, green and magenta paint
quality_note: Photo of a glossy canvas with visible sheen and uneven lighting; slight skew, with a small white wedge at the top-right corner.
old_desc: A cat rendered in playful colour becomes both companion and mischief-maker.

depicted: A round canvas showing red-orange autumn trees with black trunks and branches on the right, their foliage spilling over orange ground, beside a grey river or lake on the left with small red leaves floating on the water. The sky is grey and the artist's signature sits at the bottom.
subjects: fallen red leaves floating on water
issues: Title fits (there is a river with leaves on it), but the description's 'drifting greens' is wrong - there is no green in the painting; the palette is red-orange, grey, black and white. 'Remembered rather than seen' is a hedge, and the round canvas format goes unmentioned.
proposed_desc_en: On a round canvas, a stand of flame-red trees with black trunks leans over a grey river, and the only colour on the water is the scatter of fallen red leaves drifting past. Everything but the autumn foliage is kept to grey, black and white.
alt_text: Round canvas: red-orange autumn trees with black trunks beside a grey river dotted with fallen red leaves
quality_note: Photographed round canvas lying on a white surface; the canvas rim and its shadow are visible, so the image is not cropped to the artwork.
old_desc: Water, branches, and drifting greens weave together into a landscape that feels remembered rather than seen.

depicted: A stylised Ganesha with large flowing ears and a curled trunk, painted in orange, yellow and red with a red tilak on the forehead, against a deep blue textured ground framed by red vertical borders; the Devanagari word 'श्री' (Shri) is painted in red on the left. Green and pink leaf and petal shapes fill the lower part of the picture.
real_world_reference: Ganesha (Hindu elephant-headed deity), with 'श्री' (Shri) written in Devanagari script
subjects: blue textured background with red vertical borders
green and pink leaf and petal shapes
two small yellow flame- or bud-like shapes at the sides
issues: The subject is unmistakably Ganesha, with 'श्री' in Devanagari, yet neither title nor description names him; 'devotional figure' is a hedge. 'Ornament' is not visible - the face is plain apart from a red tilak. The title is generic but not false.
proposed_desc_en: Ganesha, painted in warm orange and yellow against a deep blue ground, curls his trunk to one side beneath a red tilak, with 'Shri' written in red Devanagari beside him. Green and pink leaf and petal shapes gather at the bottom of the picture.
alt_text: Stylised Ganesha in orange and yellow on a blue background, with the Devanagari word Shri in red beside him
quality_note: Low-resolution (679x479) and soft; the bottom of the composition appears cropped by the photo, with a dark band along the lower edge.
old_desc: A devotional figure glows with symbolic intensity, offering serenity through ornament and light.

depicted: A man in a red jacket and a woman in a blue dress, seen from behind, embrace under a single grey umbrella on a teal-blue path strewn with red leaves, flanked by autumn trees in red, orange and yellow. The Eiffel Tower stands pale in the centre of the background against a light sky.
real_world_reference: Eiffel Tower, Paris
subjects: autumn trees with red, orange and yellow leaves
issues: The Eiffel Tower is plainly painted, so 'imagined Paris' is a needless hedge, and there is one umbrella shared by a couple, not two. No rain is actually visible - the umbrella implies it. The title is acceptable, though 'of Memory' is filler.
proposed_desc_en: A couple walk arm in arm under one grey umbrella along a blue path lined with red and orange autumn trees, and the Eiffel Tower rises pale and tall in the gap between them. Fallen leaves speckle the path at their feet.
alt_text: Couple embracing under a grey umbrella on a path between autumn trees, the Eiffel Tower behind them
quality_note: Canvas edge visible as a thin dark border along the top and left; otherwise clean.
old_title: Paris in the Rain of Memory
old_desc: Two umbrellas hold their own small world before an imagined Paris, where romance and weather arrive together.

depicted: A large butterfly with blue, yellow and green wings, red edges and white eye-spots occupies the left two-thirds, painted on a coarse brown textured ground; a small pink butterfly, an orange-yellow butterfly and a small green butterfly sit in the right portion. A vertical brown strip or seam runs through the centre of the image.
subjects: vertical strip or seam through the centre
issues: There are four butterflies - one large, three small - not 'twin butterflies', so the 'visual rhyme / symmetry' premise is invented. The coarse brown textured ground and the vertical seam through the middle go unmentioned. The title is vague but not contradicted by the picture.
proposed_desc_en: A large butterfly with blue, yellow and green wings edged in red and dotted with white eye-spots fills most of the picture, painted on a coarse brown ground. Three smaller butterflies - pink, orange-yellow and green - flutter in the open space to its right.
alt_text: Large blue-and-yellow butterfly with red-edged wings on a brown ground, three smaller butterflies beside it
quality_note: Tightly cropped photo: the large butterfly's upper wings are cut by the top edge and the signature at bottom right is partly cut; a vertical brown strip or seam runs through the centre, likely a panel join or surface seam; wide 1.8:1 ratio.
old_desc: Twin butterflies repeat each other like visual rhyme, turning symmetry into motion.

depicted: A woman seen from behind, dark hair in a bun with a red flower, in a blue sleeveless top with hands on hips, her wide red skirt flaring across the lower half of the canvas. Behind her, three couples in dance poses appear as dark silhouettes against a speckled background of blue, yellow, red and green.
real_world_reference: Resembles a flamenco dancer (flounced red skirt, flower in hair bun, hands on hips); the dance style is inferred, not labelled
issues: She is a dancer, almost certainly flamenco-style (flounced red skirt, flower in bun, hands on hips), with dancing couples behind her - so there is a setting, and 'stands inside a mood more than a setting' is a hedge. 'Glamour and mystery' misses the obvious subject: dance. The title's 'Scarlet' fits.
proposed_desc_en: A dancer with her back to us, a red flower in her dark bun, plants her hands on her hips as her red skirt flares out across the whole lower half of the picture. Behind her, dancing couples appear as dark silhouettes against bands of blue, yellow, red and green.
alt_text: Dancer seen from behind in a blue top and swirling red skirt, hands on hips, silhouetted couples dancing behind
old_desc: A woman in red stands inside a mood more than a setting, poised between glamour and mystery.

depicted: The lakeside village of Hallstatt: a tall white church with a slender pointed spire, rows of cream, ochre and white houses with grey roofs along the shore, a larger building on the wooded slope at right, snow-streaked grey-blue mountains behind, and a still lake in the foreground reflecting lit yellow windows. The sky is pale lilac-grey.
real_world_reference: Hallstatt, Austria (the classic lakeside view with the Evangelical church spire and the Alpine peaks behind)
mood: still, cool and quiet, with warmth from the lit windows
issues: This is a recognisable view of Hallstatt, Austria, which neither title nor description names. There is no harbour and there are no boats, just the lakeshore; 'a place invented for evening' wrongly suggests an imaginary town, and the pale overcast sky reads as daylight even though the windows glow.
proposed_desc_en: Hallstatt on its Austrian lake: the slender white church spire, cream and ochre houses stepping down to the water, and snow-streaked peaks behind, with lit windows glimmering in the still reflection.
alt_text: Hallstatt lakeside village with white church spire, pastel houses and snow-streaked mountains reflected in the lake
quality_note: Photo is slightly soft and low in contrast; edges are tightly cropped with no frame margin.
old_desc: A lakeside town gathers itself into reflection and warmth, like a place invented for evening.

depicted: A hillside of white houses with red-tiled roofs above a deep blue sea, with grey-brown mountains across the water and palm trees at right. A white balustrade runs diagonally through the foreground with four white seagulls standing on it; striped sun umbrellas, tables and a white picket fence sit on a terrace, and pink, red and blue flowering shrubs fill the lower corners. Signed 'Pinkal' at bottom right.
real_world_reference: Resembles a Mediterranean coastal town in the Amalfi or Riviera manner; no specific landmark identifiable
issues: The title holds (blue sea, coast). The description is generic: 'layered distance' and 'dream of travel and return' could describe any seascape, and it omits the painting's most distinctive details, the four seagulls on the balustrade, the striped umbrellas and the pink and blue blossom.
proposed_desc_en: A sunlit coast of white, red-roofed houses and palm trees above a deep blue sea, where four seagulls perch along a white balustrade beside striped umbrellas and bursts of pink and blue blossom.
alt_text: Red-roofed white houses above a blue sea, palm trees, and four seagulls on a white balustrade beside pink flowers
old_desc: Town and sea meet in layered distance, opening a panoramic dream of travel and return.

depicted: A salmon-pink villa with red-tiled roofs, a round domed turret, arched blue windows and warm lit windows stands beside a tall multi-tiered waterfall between towering trees. In front, a stone arch bridge with ornamental urns and lamp posts crosses a rushing white stream; red and green shrubs, flower beds, boulders and a stone path fill the garden under a hazy pale sky. Signed 'Pinkal' at bottom left.
real_world_reference: Resembles the Thomas Kinkade cottage-and-garden genre; no specific real place
mood: lush and storybook-romantic, warm lamplight against cool mist
issues: Both fit; the description omits the arched stone bridge with urns and lamp posts that dominates the foreground.
proposed_desc_en: A pink villa with a domed turret glows beside a tall, many-tiered waterfall, while a stone bridge with urns and lamp posts arches over the white water rushing through a garden of red and green.
alt_text: Pink villa with red roofs beside a tall waterfall; a stone bridge with lamps and urns crosses a rushing stream
quality_note: Upper sky area looks washed out, possibly glare rather than painted mist; top edge tightly cropped.
old_desc: A home near the cascade feels tucked inside a fairy-tale geography of mist and stone.

depicted: A stone cottage with a pale roof, white door and glowing yellow windows sits among pink blossoming trees and evergreens on a green lawn. Signed at top left.
real_world_reference: Resembles the Thomas Kinkade cottage genre; no specific real place
issues: A stone bridge is present, so the title holds, though the cottage and the two swans are just as prominent. The description is generic and omits the cottage, the swans and the blossoming trees; nothing visible supports 'old crossing' or 'nostalgia'.
proposed_desc_en: A stone cottage with a pale roof and lit windows sits among spring blossoms, as two white swans glide down the stream toward a stone arch bridge under a clear sky.
alt_text: Stone cottage with lit windows, a stone arch bridge over a stream, and two white swans among flowering shrubs
quality_note: Low-resolution image (434 x 297) with soft detail; a better photo is needed before this can be shown large.
old_desc: River and bridge hold the scene together with the quiet nostalgia of an old crossing.

real_world_reference: Resembles the Thomas Kinkade cabin genre; no specific real place
mood: wholesome, bright and peaceful, with a quietly romantic note
issues: The cabin is the main subject, but 'Dream Current' is filler. The description omits the couple with a bicycle, the wooden footbridge, the waterfall, the rowing boat and the snow-capped mountains, all clearly visible, and 'refuge and reverie' says nothing about the picture.
proposed_desc_en: A log cabin with glowing windows looks out over a bright meadow beneath snow-capped peaks; a couple wheeling a bicycle heads for the wooden footbridge where a waterfall feeds the river, and a rowing boat waits on the bank.
alt_text: Log cabin with lit windows below snowy mountains; a couple with a bicycle walks toward a wooden bridge over a river
quality_note: Highlights in the sky and waterfall look slightly overexposed; edges tightly cropped.

proposed_desc_en: A thatched cottage washed in lavender, blue and gold shines above banks of pink, red and white flowers, with a small white footbridge at the left and water lilies opening across the pond in front.

issues: Both fit loosely; neither mentions the water, the moored boats, the rowing boat with two figures or the birds, which fill most of the canvas, and 'last rooftops' is vaguer than the lit high-rises actually shown.

depicted: A young girl with a light-brown ponytail tied with a red bow, wearing a yellow top and a pink skirt, kneels in tall green grass with her eyes closed and kisses a white rabbit on the nose; the rabbit sits upright facing her. The background is a mottled brown and olive wash.

depicted: Seven horses, three white and four brown, gallop through white sea foam straight toward the viewer at night, with a full moon, two birds and dark mountains behind them. Rocks and a patch of green grass sit at the bottom right, a bare tree at the far right.
real_world_reference: The 'Seven Running Horses' motif, a popular Indian good-luck picture (Vastu / Feng Shui), echoing the seven horses of Surya's chariot.
issues: Neither says there are seven horses, which is the whole point of this traditional good-luck motif, nor that it is a moonlit night scene; 'light' and 'brightness' undersell that.
proposed_desc_en: Seven horses, three white and four brown, gallop through moonlit surf straight towards you, a full moon and dark mountains behind them. It is the much-loved seven-running-horses picture, set here at night.
alt_text: Seven horses, three white and four brown, gallop through surf toward the viewer under a full moon and dark mountains.
quality_note: Low-resolution photo (748 px wide), slightly soft, colours a little flat.
old_desc: Running horses cut through water and brightness with a force that feels wild and freeing.

issues: Both fit but are vague: the 'human crossing' is a horse-drawn carriage on a stone arch bridge, and there is also a tiny rowing boat with two figures on the river below.

quality_note: Slightly soft photo; narrow image, only 476 px wide.

issues: Written blind: this is a photograph of eight miniature tree paintings on small wooden easels, not a single painting of a grove, and the 'landscape learning to become art' line describes nothing in the image. The 'nature' category also misfiles what is a series/display photo.
proposed_desc_en: Eight miniature canvases on tiny wooden easels, each a single tree through the year: blossom with red birds, a night pine forest, snow with a snowman, autumn gold with a tyre swing, summer green with a bench. A small series, photographed together on a shelf.
